title: 第145章 斗转星移！！！
slug: 综艺大导演从齐聚初代跑男开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“吴导，我可不可以再发动一次超能力，真的让时光倒流呢？”

王祖兰期待的眼神看着吴凡。

吴凡也看着王祖兰。

然后看向广场上那些满含期待的脸庞。

微笑着用最郑重的声音回答了他：“当然可以！”

王祖兰顿时哈哈大笑起来，笑得眼睛眯成了两道月牙。

“太好了！所有朋友们！包括直播间的朋友们！让我们一起喊出这个超能力的名字！重新发动一次属于我们的超能力！好不好！”

“好！！！”

所有人异口同声。

广场上、直播间里，同时爆发出了今天最整齐、最响亮、最震耳欲聋的呐喊。

王祖兰深吸一口气，目光从兄弟团脸上缓缓扫过，然后面对着大屏幕，面对着五百位粉丝。

此刻直播间的人数已经突破八百万人！

八百万同时在线的观众！

他攥紧了拳头，一字一句，直接用尽全身力气嘶吼出来：“我要发动超能力！”

“斗！转！星！移！！！”

“斗转星移！！！”

所有的粉丝们都在呐喊！

直播间里的弹幕也全部变成了这四个字。

把整个画面完全遮住。

不需要彩排，因为这一刻他们已经等了太久太久。

下一秒！

超能力似乎真的发动了！

大屏幕上，画面本来是锁在最后一期结束场景上的。

突然间开始疯狂回溯！

所有的画面开始倒放，所有人的动作全部倒退。

真的像是时光倒流一样。

画面在疯狂倒退！

而回忆也在这个时候，疯狂的侵袭着每个人的大脑。

就这样倒退倒退。

倒退到原点！

倒退到第一季第一期的画面。

兄弟团初次齐聚的场景。

当画面停格在雷锋塔的时候，整座雷峰塔的灯光全部亮了起来。

在午后的阳光下依旧璀璨耀眼。

像是一个守护了十二年的老朋友，终于在今天等到了所有人的归来。

“大家好，我是魅力领袖，邓朝！”

邓朝脸上带着一抹邪魅的笑容，和大屏幕上那个的年轻人一模一样。

眉宇间那种搞怪又自信的神态，和十二年前严丝合缝地重叠在了一起。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Director Wu, can I activate my super power again and really turn back time?"

Wang Zulan looked at Wu Fan expectantly.

Wu Fan also looked at Wang Zulan.

Then look at the expectant faces in the square.

Smiling and answering him in the most solemn voice: "Of course!"

Wang Zulan suddenly burst into laughter, his eyes narrowed into two crescents.

"Great! All my friends! Including the friends in the live broadcast room! Let's shout out the name of this super power together! Let's activate our super power again! Okay!"

"Okay!!!"

Everyone said in unison.

In the square and in the live broadcast room, the most uniform, loudest, and most deafening shouts today broke out at the same time.

Wang Zulan took a deep breath and slowly swept his eyes across the faces of the brothers, then faced the big screen and five hundred fans.

At this moment, the number of people in the live broadcast room has exceeded 8 million!

Eight million simultaneous online viewers!

He clenched his fists and screamed out with all his strength, word by word: "I want to activate my super power!"

"Fight! Turn! Star! Shift!!!"

"The stars have changed!!!"

All the fans are shouting!

All the comments in the live broadcast room changed to these four words.

Completely cover the entire screen.

No rehearsal was needed because they had been waiting for this moment for so long.

The next second!

The superpower seems to be really activated!

On the big screen, the picture was originally locked to the ending scene of the last issue.

Suddenly the crazy backtracking started!

All the pictures began to play backwards, and everyone's movements went backwards.

It's really like stepping back in time.

The screen is going backwards like crazy!

And memories are also at this time, crazily invading everyone's brain.

Just go backwards and forwards.

Go back to the starting point!

Go back to the first episode of the first season.

The scene where the brothers get together for the first time.

When the screen stopped at Leifeng Tower, the lights of the entire Leifeng Tower lit up.

Still dazzling in the afternoon sun.

It's like an old friend who has been guarding for twelve years finally waits for everyone's return today.

"Hello everyone, I am the charismatic leader, Deng Chao!"

Deng Chao had an evil smile on his face, exactly like the young man on the big screen.

The funny and confident expression between his eyebrows exactly overlapped with that of twelve years ago.
